questions.prompt: Which modifier makes a member accessible from any code?

questions.explanation: internal limits visibility to the current assembly.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to make a field accessible only within its class
questions.explanation: private is the most restrictive member access.

options: The class and its derived classes
questions.explanation: protected spans the type and its subtypes.

questions.prompt: Define class Safe with private int Code=1234 and public bool Check(int c) returning c==Code, then print Check(1234)

questions.explanation: It is the union of protected and internal.

questions.prompt: Arrange from most to least restrictive typical modifiers
questions.explanation: private is most restrictive, public least.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to make a member accessible in same assembly and derived classes anywhere
questions.explanation: protected internal is the union of both.

options: Derived classes within the same assembly
questions.explanation: It is the intersection of private and protected.
